title: Galois objects dominate connected objects
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,F)$ be a Galois category [def-galois-category] and $X$ a connected object of $\mathcal C$ [def-galois-connected-object]. Then there are a Galois object $Z$ of $\mathcal C$ (a connected object such that $\operatorname{Aut}(Z)$ acts transitively on $F(Z)$, equivalently $\#\operatorname{Aut}(Z)=\#F(Z)$, as in [lem-galois-axioms](6)) and a morphism $Z\to X$. (The construction: the symmetric group acts on the $n$-fold product $X^n$, $n=\#F(X)$, and one takes a connected component of $X^n$ whose fibre contains a tuple of pairwise distinct elements.)

source.place: node lem-galois-object-exists, order 971; literature: literature/stacks-project/pione.tex, Fundamental Groups of Schemes, Lemma 0BN2 (label lemma-galois)

proof.text: Bundle the finite sets F(X) as a functor Fprime to FintypeCat using ObjectProperty.lift and finiteness from [def-galois-category]. Its composite with FintypeCat.incl is definitionally F. Since the inclusion reflects limits, colimits and isomorphisms, the finite exactness and conservativity of F transfer to Fprime [def-galois-exact-functor].

Construct the Mathlib PreGaloisCategory instance. Finite limits and colimits [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits] give terminal objects, pullbacks and finite coproducts. For finite-group quotients, move the finite group to Type 0 by Finite.exists_type_univ_nonempty_mulEquiv, use the finite-colimit assumption and transport along its SingleObj equivalence. The summand axiom is exactly [lem-galois-stacks-mono-complement]. For FiberFunctor Fprime, preservation of epis follows from [lem-galois-axioms](2), and preservation of finite-group quotients follows by the same universe transport from finite exactness. Compose Fprime with FintypeCat.uSwitch to obtain a fibre functor in the hom universe and hence a Mathlib GaloisCategory instance.

Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.exists_hom_from_galois_of_connected to Fprime and X. Connectedness [def-galois-connected-object] is already the identical Mathlib predicate, so it gives Z, a morphism Z -> X, and Mathlib IsGalois Z. This reuses the finite self-product and connected-component argument in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Galois.Decomposition instead of reconstructing it.

Mathlib IsGalois Z supplies IsConnected Z. Choose a point z of Fprime(Z) using nonempty_fiber_of_isConnected. Mathlib evaluation_aut_bijective_of_isGalois gives a bijection Aut(Z) -> Fprime(Z) at z. Nat.card_eq_of_bijective identifies their cardinalities, which together with connectedness is precisely IsStacksGaloisObject F Z as defined in [lem-galois-axioms]. Keep the morphism Z -> X from the preceding step.
